title: Value-only motion
one_liner: Your face does the talking; graphics only fire on the claims, numbers and numbered steps, so every one feels like a reward.
best_for: Framework, mindset and money reels with a number or a '3 reasons' list: 'here's why', 'number two', 'from X to 10x'.
effort: Medium: one take, a 2-minute pass to tag your value sentences, then Claude builds it.

palette.use: the ONE accent: lit chapter boxes, handwriting, stamps, the active caption word, the concept field (swap for your brand colour)
tape strips, the number field, linework
condensed type, handwriting on fields, captions

pace: 1.1x, jump cuts hidden by hard-cut punch-ins (1.06-1.08); 6 value events in 29 s, 34% animated, longest bare-face stretch 5.5 s.
signature_moves: Animate value, never delivery: claims, numbers and numbered steps get a graphic; stories stay on your bare face
Condensed all-caps word on torn tape, paired with a pen-traced handwritten note in your own words
Numbered chapter rail (1 2 3) that lights up as you reach each point, so viewers can see how far through they are
